dogecoin.text: Another crypto-currency mania takes over as a parabolic rally for altcoins outside Bitcoin, makes the value of all digital tokens worth +$2.3T. Dogecoin a crypto that started as a joke, now trades at $0.68, up +63% in past 24 hrs, +131% over past wk, &  over +11K% so far in 2021.

Cryptocurrency Dogecoin briefly surged to an all-time high of 69 cents this week. One can calculate that a $1,000 dogecoin investment on Jan. 1, 2021, when it sold for less than a cent per coin, would of been worth $121,052 at Wednesday’s high of $0.69, a gain of over 12,000%.

Christine Lagarde, President of the ECB  named a number of altcoins that have rallied tremendously in recent months. Includes Ethereum, Cardano, BNB, XRP, Solana & Dogecoin. The ECB President refers to all of these cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, as highly speculative assets
